verdict.rationale: Twenty documents workflow automations triggered by schedules, webhooks, or record changes that can chain multiple steps (record ops, HTTP requests, code, AI Agent, delay), and separately describes AI agents that autonomously execute multi-step tasks like enrichment within a permission model — together enabling background autonomous automation setups. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that these automations run reliably unattended in production (community evidence only notes general 'alpha' rough edges, not automation-specific failures), and no case study showing long-running autonomous execution.
